messages:
maya: Heads-up — trying to standardize how we do joint SEV channels / war rooms with SI and HW partners. proposal attached below, want quick sanity check before i share with partnerships+support.
adarsh: SGTM. can you paste the minimal checklist here? short bullets work.
maya: yep. core idea: a single ephemeral channel per incident + persistent liaison thread. channel naming: `#partner-<shortname>-sev-<YYYYMMDD>` e.g. `#partner-orion-sev-20240203`. ownership: partner-liaison + redwood-runner. triggers: pd escalation -> creates channel via bot. Notify list: @oncall, @partners-liaison, partner-technical-contact.
paul: love the naming. question: how do we handle cross-region fallbacks? if partner fails to join the bridge, we try fallback model variant and note in channel? :thinking:
maya: good Q. fallback policy in runbook: step 1) attempt partner bridge (3 tries / 10m), step 2) switch to fallback model variant and tag `#ops-fallback` in thread, step 3) post incident summary to partnership-ops channel for SLA impact. i added this as a short decision table.
jen: can we automate the 3 tries? have the bot re-post and escalate to partner pager if no ack.
partners-bot: created channel `#partner-orion-sev-20240203` and invited maya, adarsh, paul, jen, lucas, partners-liaison, @orion-tech
lucas: quick nit — add explicit handback step for postmortem ownership. partner should be lead for root cause if the failure originated in their infra, otherwise redwood leads.
maya: yep added. also adding a tiny checklist to paste at channel top (pin):
```
Incident checklist (pin):
- Trigger source & pd id
- Partner contact + escalation tree
- Current mitigation + who executed
- Fallback action taken (if any)
- Time to partner ack
- PM/CS notified?
```
adarsh: who owns running the canary rollback if fallback model is worse? ops or partner?
jen: ops owns immediate mitigation (rollback/canary) to protect customers. partner assists with deeper fix. record decision in channel.
paul: recommend we add an automated daily sync for any channels still open >24h: bot posts "status-check" and pings liaison + eng lead.
maya: agreed — adding automation item. draft of the public-facing blurb for partners:
"We will create a short-lived shared Slack channel for incidents related to joint integrations. This channel is created automatically on SEV-level PagerDuty escalation, includes both teams' liaisons, and follows a clear checklist (ack, mitigation, fallback, handback, postmortem)."
lucas: thumbs up from me. small ask: include a CSV template for partner contacts so onboarding can populate PD rules and channel invites automatically.
partners-bot: reminder scheduled: post daily status-check at 09:00 UTC for any active `#partner-*` channels older than 24h.
maya: awesome — i'll consolidate and push to partnerships playbook after a quick review. anyone want to add objections now? otherwise i'll annex this to the partner ops repo and loop in support.
paul: none from me. go ahead.
jen: fine here. :thumbsup:
adarsh: no objections. thanks maya.
maya: thanks all — i'll post the playbook link when done."
